preconditions.description: The number of cities N must be between 2 and 200.
The number of roads M must be between 1 and 50,000.
The prices of gold and silver coins G and S must be between 1 and 10^9 tugriks.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= N and 1 <= yi <= N and 1 <= gi <= 10**9 and 1 <= si <= 10**9 for xi, yi, gi, si in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect valid cities and have valid gold and silver requirements.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal cost of the gift in tugriks.
The minimal cost must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: any(gi <= min_gold and si <= min_silver for gi, si in roads)
postconditions.description: The gift must satisfy the gold and silver requirements for all roads.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"2 <= N <= 200","description":"The number of cities N must be between 2 and 200."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= M <= 50000","description":"The number of roads M must be between 1 and 50,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= G <= 10**9 and 1 <= S <= 10**9","description":"The prices of gold and silver coins G and S must be between 1 and 10^9 tugriks."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(1 <= xi <= N and 1 <= yi <= N and 1 <= gi <= 10**9 and 1 <= si <= 10**9 for xi, yi, gi, si in roads)","description":"Each road must connect valid cities and have valid gold and silver requirements."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str(min_cost)","description":"The output must be the minimal cost of the gift in tugriks."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"min_cost >= 0","description":"The minimal cost must be a non-negative integer."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"any(gi <= min_gold and si <= min_silver for gi, si in roads)","description":"The gift must satisfy the gold and silver requirements for all roads."}],"invariants":[]}
